event.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez Resigns Following Ethics Panel Findings on Misconduct
event.canonical_title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez Resigns Following Ethics Panel Findings on Misconduct
event.summary: Representative Jimmy Gomez has announced his resignation effective December 1 after a House Ethics Committee found substantial evidence of sexual misconduct, including unwanted sexual advances towards a staffer. Gomez disputed the allegations but stated that he felt he had no choice but to resign.

timeline.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez Resigns Following Ethics Panel Findings on Misconduct
timeline.summary: Representative Jimmy Gomez, a Democrat from California, announced his resignation effective December 1 after a House Ethics panel found evidence of sexual misconduct. This resignation follows Gomez's loss in the recent reelection bid and marks him as the second California Democrat to resign this year over similar allegations.
key_facts: Rep. Jimmy Gomez resigns effective December 1.
House Ethics panel found evidence of sexual misconduct.
Gomez lost his reelection bid in November.
He is the second California Democrat to resign this year over misconduct allegations.
